scope: This snapshot covers linked Proposal records and parsed HGAB POW line-item data available for review; it is not a whole-program inventory. Proposal source documents link to DPWH Transparency. HGAB PDF links are NR and are not published.

powBillMerges.metal structure accessories bolts and ro: metal structure accessories bolts and rods

powBillLabels.metal structure accessories bolts and ro: Metal Structure Accessories, Bolts and Rods

hgabCoverage.documentCoverageMethod: A project is counted as having Senate document evidence when a first-page native-text scan finds an exact normalized title or conservative relaxed POW title candidate in a Senate-provided BP 202 or POW file, or the existing advance-copy POW crosswalk assigns a unique exact title. DPWH Transparency Proposal links remain separate. This is file-presence evidence, not content verification; POW bill extraction may lag.

senateSupportingDocumentCoverage.deduplication: Project counts use distinct House HGAB row IDs. File counts are distinct source paths within a project and type; byte-identical copies at different paths are not removed. T5 file-type counts inherit only from uniquely resolved HGAB file codes.
senateSupportingDocumentCoverage.matchingMethod: Native text from the first PDF page. Exact normalized full-title matches and conservative relaxed title candidates are counted. Other files inherit a match only when they share a five-digit HGAB file code with a title-matched sibling and that code resolves to one House row. Image-only documents without extracted text and without a matched sibling remain unassigned.

localT5Inventory.source: T5 hash audit plus verified Cloudflare intake journal; exact manifest paths/hashes deduplicated

cloudflareFileInventory.source: Cloudflare-file-links.jsonl; reconciled to the T5 hash audit and verified intake journal

t5CloudflareReconciliation.source: T5 hash audit plus verified Cloudflare intake journal; exact manifest paths/hashes deduplicated
